descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Sunny' New Golden Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introducing Acer shirasawanum ‘Sunny’, a beautiful golden Japanese maple that offers vibrant yellow color throughout the spring and summer. This unique variety of Acer shirasawanum was introduced as a chance seedling by the same nurseryman who found and introduced ‘Mystic Mikawa’, ‘Fragrant Fountain’ and ‘Sir Damon’. ‘Sunny’ will reach 6-8 ft in 10 years if provided with adequate protection from the hot afternoon sun. The fall colors of 'Sunny' will range from orange to red. Be one of the first to get this fun new golden yellow maple and enjoy its beauty for years to come. The 2 quart square size is comparable to a typical nursery trade 1 gallon. The Large 2 Quart square would be comparable to a large 1 gallon.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Sunny' 新品金叶满月日本枫，适生区 5-9。Acer shirasawanum 'Sunny' 是一款优美的金叶日本枫，整个春夏季都能保持鲜艳的黄色。这一独特的 Acer shirasawanum 品种，是由发现并引入 ‘Mystic Mikawa’、‘Fragrant Fountain’ 和 ‘Sir Damon’ 的同一位苗圃育种者，从偶发实生苗中选出并推出的。若能为 'Sunny' 提供足够的炎热午后遮阴条件，10 年内可长至 6-8 英尺。'Sunny' 的秋色范围从橙色到红色。欢迎率先收藏这款有趣的新金黄色枫树，并在未来多年欣赏它的美感。2 夸脱方盆规格大致相当于常规苗圃贸易规格的 1 加仑盆；Large 2 Quart square 则大致相当于偏大的 1 加仑盆。
